title: Homogeneous cocycles and inhomogeneous two-cocycles
statement: For every field K, the continuous homogeneous degree-two cocycle space for galoisUnitsTopRep K is equivalent to the explicitly defined continuous inhomogeneous two-cocycle space.

proof.text: Use Mathlib InfiniteGalois.instCompactSpaceAlgEquivOfIsGalois to obtain local compactness of the absolute Galois group. Equip the separable closure temporarily with the discrete topology. Mathlib stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral and continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen prove its action is continuous. Units.ext identifies the fibers of the additive unit action with field-element fibers, proving joint continuity of the actual coefficient action.

On invariant degree-two cochains define coordinates f(g,h)=f(1,g,gh). Evaluation is jointly continuous by local compactness. Reconstruct with a continuous map on (G × G) × G sending (a,b,c) to rho(a)(f(a⁻¹b,b⁻¹c)); curry it twice. Expanding the coinduced action proves invariance. Group cancellation and equivariance prove both inverse identities.

Expand the recursive homogeneous differential in degree two to f(b,c,d) - (f(a,c,d) - (f(a,b,d) - f(a,b,c))). Evaluating at (1,g,gh,g(hi)) and using invariance gives the displayed inhomogeneous cocycle equation. Conversely apply rho(a) to that equation at (a⁻¹b,b⁻¹c,c⁻¹d); cancellation gives zero homogeneous differential.

Use KernelFork.mapIsoOfIsLimit with homogeneousCochains.cyclesIsKernel and TopModuleCat.isLimitKer to identify categorical cycles with the explicit differential kernel. Compose the proved kernel equivalence with the equivalence between a ContinuousMap with the cocycle identity and a function with continuity and the same identity.
